solution:

Architecture Programme:

2004 vs 2003: 800 (in 2004) > 650 (in 2003) - Increase

**2005 vs 2004: 450 (in 2005) 450 (in 2002) - Increase

2004 vs 2003: 980 (in 2004) > 600 (in 2003) - Increase

2005 vs 2004: 990 (in 2005) > 980 (in 2004) - Increase

Pure Sciences Programme:

2003 vs 2002: 550 (in 2003) > 300 (in 2002) - Increase

2004 vs 2003: 1020 (in 2004) > 550 (in 2003) - Increase

2005 vs 2004: 1400 (in 2005) > 1020 (in 2004) - Increase

The only instance where the number of students admitted was less than the previous year is in the Architecture Pro
gramme in the year 2005.
